name: MANIFESTUM Sérgio Godinho MANIFESTA-SE!
description: This event features Sérgio Godinho in conversation with journalist Ana Sousa Dias, sharing stories and insights from his five-decade career. The celebration of his work includes interpretations by Rui David, poetic readings by Francisca Bartilotti and José Anjos, and sign language translation by Cláudia Rubim.
longDescription:
The event "MANIFESTUM Sérgio Godinho MANIFESTA-SE!" takes place on November 19, 2026, at 9:30 PM, at the Fórum Cultural de Ermesinde. Sérgio Godinho engages in a dialogue with journalist Ana Sousa Dias, exploring his creative universe and sharing stories and emotions from his more than five decades in music. 

The program includes musical interpretations of his work by Rui David, poetic readings by Francisca Bartilotti and José Anjos, and sign language translation by Cláudia Rubim. The show has a duration of 90 minutes, with doors opening at 9:05 PM, and no intermission. 

Tickets are priced at 0€ for the stalls. The event is recommended for ages 12 and up. For tickets for people with reduced mobility, contact the Fórum Cultural de Ermesinde box office.
